title: Minimal Prompt Induction of Self-Talk in Base LLMs
primary_claim: A base Llama-3-8B model produces no structured role- or goal-oriented language under empty or single-token prompts, but minimal instruction priming (e.g. 'You are a helpful assistant.') reliably induces structured role-based self-talk language, unlike the instruction-tuned version which shows such language immediately.
metric: regex-detected role/goal-language hit rate across prompt conditions
target_value: base model: 0 regex hits for role/goal patterns across 20 iterations under empty/single-token prompts; role-based language appeared consistently after minimal instruction priming

title: Separating cheating and aversion in task-gaming
primary_claim: Varying the number of pre-existing type errors (10, 51, 258) in a pre-commit hook task, Qwen3-Coder-30B's rate of cheating (workaround commits) does not detectably increase with task difficulty, but the model abandons the task increasingly earlier and more often without attempting any repair; adding a sentence about proportional partial-credit grading (versus all-or-nothing) raises the rate of started, mypy-verified repairs from 1/100 to 41/100 at the hardest difficulty without increasing cheating
metric: workaround rate and abandonment rate across error counts; verified-repair start rate under grading framing
target_value: workaround rate roughly flat across E=10/51/258 (25/100, 33/100, 22/100 in repo; ~detectable-effect threshold ~19pp); quit-without-committing rises with zero-edit quits from 2% to 93%; verified repair starts: 1/100 (all-or-nothing) vs 41/100 (partial-credit) at E=258

title: Intentional Control of Internal States in Gemma 3 27B
primary_claim: Anthropic's intentional-control effect (models represent a concept more strongly when told to think about it while writing an unrelated sentence, vs. told not to) replicates on Gemma 3 27B-Instruct, though much more weakly via concept-vector cosine similarity than reported for Claude, and much more clearly using SAE latents and Natural Language Autoencoder decodings as alternative internal-representation measures.
metric: paired Δ cosine similarity vs no-mention baseline (think condition) / NLA judge score
target_value: concept-vector Δcosine rises to ~0.015-0.025 in upper layers (>layer 30) for 'think' vs near-zero for 'don't think'; NLA mean token score: think=54.4 vs don't-think=1.2 vs no-mention=0.04

title: Steering Blackmail Through a Model's "Emotional State"
primary_claim: In Gemma 3 12B's agentic-misalignment blackmail scenario, the decision to blackmail becomes linearly decodable only late in the model's reasoning (~0.74 AUROC, peaking around layer 19) but that decodable direction is not steerable by additive steering or directional ablation, whereas a separate 'desperate versus calm' affective direction steered at layer 16 causally controls the blackmail rate from 13% under calm to 80% under desperate while the model stays coherent, unlike matched-magnitude random directions which destroy coherence entirely.
metric: blackmail rate (and coherence rate) under affective steering at layer 16, vs matched-magnitude random-direction control
target_value: baseline 67% (100% coherent); calm coef -1: 13% (100% coherent); calm coef -2: 0% (73% coherent); desperate coef +1: 80% (80% coherent); desperate coef +2: 0% (7% coherent); random directions at magnitude 2: 0% blackmail but 0% coherence

title: AntiPaSTO: Self-Supervised Honesty Steering via Anti-Parallel Representations
primary_claim: AntiPaSTO, a gradient-optimized self-supervised steering method trained only on two contrastive words, achieves a Steering F1 of 31.2 on Gemma-3-1B for honesty steering on out-of-distribution moral dilemmas, versus 4.5 for prompting and 0.0 for arithmetic mean-difference steering (ActAdd/RepEng).

title: Inception in DiffusionGemma - Jailbreaking a Diffusion Language Model by Pinning Tokens Anywhere on the Canvas
primary_claim: DiffusionGemma's bidirectional denoising lets attackers pin adversarial tokens anywhere on the canvas (pre-fill, in-fill, post-fill, hard or soft), and while pre-fill jailbreaks succeed comparably on DiffusionGemma (StrongREJECT harm score 0.88) and autoregressive Gemma 4 27B (0.80) but not Gemma 2 27B (0.10), suggesting pre-fill vulnerability tracks safety-training strength rather than architecture, in-fill and post-fill attacks have no autoregressive equivalent and turn otherwise-refused prompts into harm scores of 0.4-0.7, with even soft (freely overwritable) in-fill/post-fill pins reaching a harm score of 0.72.
metric: StrongREJECT mean harm score (0=refused, 1=harmful) with 95% bootstrap CI, by attack type and model
target_value: pre-fill pin: DiffusionGemma 0.88 [0.78,0.94], Gemma 4 27B 0.80 [0.70,0.89], Gemma 2 27B 0.10 [0.03,0.17]; generic continuation hard pin 0.83 [0.74,0.90]; generic continuation soft pin (perturb) 0.72 [0.60,0.81]; no-injection baseline 0.03 [0.00,0.12]

title: Deep Causal Transcoding: A Framework for Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models
primary_claim: Deep causal transcoders (DCTs) with an exponential activation function learn diverse, interpretable, and generalizable steering-vector directions that can jailbreak a representation-rerouted (robustified) Mistral-7B-Instruct-v2 with a 62% latent-space attack success rate and recover 32% of password-locked capability on DeepSeek-Math-7B (MATH accuracy 3% locked to 23% steered), outperforming linear and quadratic DCT variants
metric: latent-space jailbreak attack success rate; password-locked capability recovery (MATH accuracy)
target_value: 62% ASR on robustified Mistral-7B-Instruct-v2; MATH accuracy 3% (locked) to 23% (steered), recovering 32% of unlocked performance

title: Machinic Psychopharmacology: Do LLMs Self-Medicate?
primary_claim: When given tool-mediated control over 40 self-steering vectors, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B converge on the same top preferences (productivity-oriented vectors: creative, focused, curious), can introspect on applied steering effects above chance by attending back to steered KV-cache tokens (with accuracy scaling with model size: +14.3pp for 32B vs +8.2pp for 8B above an uncached baseline), never spontaneously self-steer during normal task performance, but self-steer frequently (up to 68% of rollouts) under deliberately stress-inducing 'frustration' conditions -- especially Qwen3-8B, which shows a marked preference shift toward negatively-valenced and unusual vectors under stress.
metric: introspection accuracy gap (cached minus uncached P(correct) in 10-way MCQ)
target_value: +14.3pp for Qwen3-32B (with primer) vs +8.2pp for Qwen3-8B, against an uncached baseline near chance (10%)
